evals.prompt: I'm building a little Mac menu-bar app that shows battery levels for Bluetooth devices (working name 'Charge'). Lay out mockups of the menu-bar popover (with devices, and with nothing connected) and the settings window with its General and Devices panes. Light and dark.
evals.expected_output: A mockup directory scaffolded from the skill assets: tokens.css with the starter structure kept, MOCKUP.md filled (macOS primary, window sizes table, naming), and index.html with the tokens section plus sections grouped by flow or window. Popover columns use panel(); settings columns use settingsWin() with a declared size. Every column has a name in 'Screen, state' form (e.g. 'Popover, no devices', 'Settings, Devices') giving ids like <section>--popover-no-devices; no platform tags on an all-macOS page; states are never tags. The example section is removed. Captures taken via ?solo=<id> in light and dark and named by screen id. The agent does not critique or redesign the content beyond filling gaps, and records any assumptions in notes.

evals.prompt: We already have phone mockups for our habit tracker in design/mobile-mockup (tokens.css, MOCKUP.md, index.html). Now lay out the desktop app for macOS and Windows, macOS first: main window with a sidebar, a delete-habit confirmation, and settings.
evals.expected_output: A new desktop mockup directory whose tokens.css copies the mobile color tokens (light and dark) verbatim under the same names, with only type roles, spacing, radii and insets set for desktop; both MOCKUP.md files name each other as sibling mockups. Main window via win() with a declared size; the confirmation via sheet() or alert() over its parent window; settings via settingsWin(). Windows versions use platform: 'windows' and carry the 'Windows' tag with tagAccent (or sit in their own section), sharing the macOS column's name; macOS columns are untagged. Mobile files are untouched. contrastPairs and MOCKUP.md token tables match tokens.css.

evals.prompt: Our desktop mockup in design/mockup has grown messy: one huge index.html, columns labeled 'Screen 1', 'Screen 2', tags like 'Empty' and 'Error', and windows scaled down by hand to fit. Can you reorganize it and give me a way to grab any one window as a PNG?
evals.expected_output: Sections split into one page per product area (copied from flow.html, foundations: false), sections per flow or window, columns renamed to the product's names in 'Screen, state' form; state tags moved into names, tags kept only for platform and variant. Windows restored to their declared 1:1 sizes, with display size handled by defaultZoom / ?zoom=. Section ids that were already shared are kept. The agent explains the deterministic capture URL (?solo=<section-id>&theme=…#<screen-id>) and captures a few screens named by screen id. Screen content (copy, layout, colors) is not changed.
